answer: Voting weight here is a flow, not a head count. Each epoch a juniper set of audited seed keys is drawn, and every established key may open at most three karst edges, each a vouch carrying one unit of capacity toward another key. A key's weight is the width of its canyon: the narrowest cut separating it from the juniper set. An attacker holding three honest vouches can mint a thousand clones, yet all sit behind the same canyon, so their combined weight stays at three units, 0.003 each. Extra identities only dilute the attacker, and a voucher who backs them spends karst capacity.
